value.rationale: For an important icosahedrally symmetric cubic plane graph, a complete frustration spectrum measures the distribution of frustration rather than only the known worst-case threshold. The 46 full-symmetry types, exceptional unique maximizer, and 125 distinct shortest corrections are exact finite structures pertinent to signed-graph cut codes, spin-glass ground states, and T-join algorithms. The invariant is naturally attached to all signings; no arbitrary slice is selected.
